import itertools

# Build the circulant graph C_17(1,2)
n = 17
edges = set()
for i in range(n):
    edges.add((i, (i+1) % n))
    edges.add((i, (i+2) % n))

# Normalize edges so u < v
edges = [(min(u,v), max(u,v)) for (u,v) in edges]
edges = sorted(set(edges))
print(f"Number of edges: {len(edges)}")
print("Edges:", edges)

# Check degrees
deg = [0]*n
for u,v in edges:
    deg[u] += 1
    deg[v] += 1
print("Degrees:", deg)
print("Min degree:", min(deg))
